source: Written by hand. Codes and labels as the Skill types table of courseSkillPoints.md. skillId is keccak-256 of the code, as ethers.id(code) computes it.

skillTypes.label: Code implementation
learningOutcomes: Implement an algorithm in Python or C++.
Program an embedded board that reads sensors and drives actuators.
Test a program against its specification.

skillTypes.label: Data wrangling, statistics and visualization
learningOutcomes: Clean a data set with missing values and outliers.
Fit a statistical model, such as a regression or a time series.
Visualize data and report the analysis.

skillTypes.label: Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation
learningOutcomes: Train a supervised model and validate it on unseen data.
Cluster data or reduce its dimension.
Compare models with an evaluation metric.

skillTypes.label: Neural architectures, backpropagation, CNNs and RNNs
learningOutcomes: Derive backpropagation for a multilayer network.
Compute the forward pass of a CNN or an RNN.
Build and train a deep network in a framework.

skillTypes.label: Convex optimization, algorithms and gradient methods
learningOutcomes: Formulate an engineering problem as an optimization problem.
Derive the optimality conditions of a constrained problem.
Solve it with a gradient or iterative method.

skillTypes.label: Feedback systems, state space, stability and automation
learningOutcomes: Model a dynamic system in state space and analyze its stability.
Design and tune a feedback controller.
Program and verify the logic of an automation system.

skillTypes.label: Fourier and Z-transforms, filtering and estimation
learningOutcomes: Analyze a signal or an LTI system in the frequency domain.
Design a filter for a sampled signal.
Estimate a quantity from noisy measurements.

skillTypes.label: Power electronics, electrical machines and power generation
learningOutcomes: Design a DC-DC converter stage.
Estimate the losses and efficiency of a converter or a machine.
Compute the operating point of a transformer or an electrical machine.

skillTypes.label: Network topology, power flow, protection and state estimation
learningOutcomes: Compute the power flow of an electrical network.
Analyze faults and the protection that clears them.
Estimate the state of a grid from its measurements.

skillTypes.label: Wind, solar PV, storage and batteries
learningOutcomes: Size a wind, solar PV or hydro installation for a load.
Size a battery or storage system.
Estimate the energy yield and cost of a renewable source.

skillTypes.label: Thermal cycles, steam and gas properties, heat transfer
learningOutcomes: Find the state of a fluid with steam tables.
Compute the efficiency of a Rankine or Brayton cycle.
Estimate the temperature rise caused by losses in a machine.

skillTypes.label: Numerical modeling and simulation
learningOutcomes: Build a numerical model of a physical system.
Identify the parameters of a model from experiments.
Simulate the model and validate it against data.

skillTypes.label: Linear algebra, probability and calculus
learningOutcomes: Apply matrix decompositions to engineering problems.
Compute with probability distributions.
Solve differential and difference equations.
